items.title: AOC launches new gaming monitor with 425Hz QD-Mini LED display
items.summary: The AOC AGP277QKM has been launched in China. It's a 2K gaming monitor with a 27-inch QD-Mini LED display. There's support for Adaptive-Sync, with a maximum refresh rate of 425 Hz. The launch price is CNY 3,254, about $486.

items.title: New $80 Street Fighter II gaming watch brings arcade battles, gold detailing and retro collectables
items.summary: Street Fighter II is making its way onto a wristwatch, with a new gaming wearable that combines arcade-inspired fighting gameplay with fitness tracking and collectible detailing. Priced at $79.99, the officially licensed watch features eight original fighters, touchscreen controls and two interchangeable straps, with shipping expected in December 2026.
